sales_by_region.sql: SELECT region, category, product, amount, profit, order_date FROM sales WHERE order_date >= :from::date AND order_date <= :to::date ORDER BY region NULLS LAST, category NULLS LAST, product, id

ops_by_day.sql: SELECT day, service, team, requests, failures, avg_ms FROM ops WHERE day >= :from::date AND day <= :to::date ORDER BY day, service

finance_by_period.sql: SELECT period, cost_center, account, plan_amount, fact_amount FROM finance WHERE period >= :from::date AND period <= :to::date ORDER BY period, cost_center NULLS LAST, account

slow_probe.sql: SELECT pg_sleep(:seconds::int) IS NULL AS done
